latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of TikTok Video Editor App.

- Instantly edit and export TikTok-ready videos with AI — just describe the edit you want.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB; automatic AI editing and captioning.
- Simple onboarding: free anonymous token for 100 credits, no registration required.
- Supports fast cut, trending captions, beat sync, and export in 1080p vertical video.
- Automatic session management and clear status/error reporting for credits, exports, and uploads.
